question: What powers arise from this practice according to the teaching to the beloved?
premises: Knowledge of hearing from afar is named.
Paralysis of bonds is named likewise.
These are presented as results of the practice.
inference: The practice yields distant hearing and the paralysis of bonds.
uncertainties: pāśa-stobham may refer to arresting or paralyzing bonds or fetters.
plain_english: O beloved, one gains knowledge of hearing from afar and likewise the power to paralyze bonds.
